cues.text: Gina speaking. How can I help you?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Oh, hello - I'd like to order some stationery, please.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: And who am I speaking to?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: John Carter.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Right - can I just confirm your account number and the name of your company, John?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Sure! The account number is 6 9 2 4 double 1.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Six nine two four one one. Right, and you're from 'Rainbow Computers?'
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: No. The company is Rainbow Communications.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Oh, OK, I'll just fix that on the system ... communications. And what would you like to order, John?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Envelopes. We need a box of A4 - that is, normal size envelopes.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: White, yellow or vanilla?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: We'll have the plain white please - but the ones with the little windows.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: OK ... One box - A4 - white - just the one box, was it?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Um, on second thoughts make that two boxes. We go through heaps of envelopes. As a matter of interest. Are they made from recycled paper?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: No. You can't get white recycled paper. The recycled ones are grey and they're more expensive actually.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Right - we'll stick to white then.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Something else, John?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, we need some coloured photocopy paper. What colours do you have?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: We've got purple, light blue, blue, light green - whatever you want, pretty much. There are 500 sheets to the pack.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Let's see ...we're going to need a lot of blue paper for our new price lists so can you give us ten packs, please. Make sure it's the light blue though...
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Ten packs of the light blue.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Anything else that we can help you with?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Let me think ... what else do we need? I'm sure there was something else.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Pens, paper clips, fax paper, computer supplies, office furniture?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Oh, yes! We need floppy disks - do you have those nice coloured ones?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes, but they're a bit more expensive than the black ones.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: That's alright. I'm not paying, anyway!
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Right. Floppy disks. And what about diaries for next year? We've got them in stock already and it's a good idea to order early.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: No - I think we're alright for diaries but something we do need is one of those big wall calendars - you know, one that shows the whole year at a glance. Do you stock those?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: We certainly do.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: OK - can you include a wall calendar then, with the other stuff. Just make sure it's got the whole year on the one side.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Sure - and do you have a copy of our new catalogue?
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: No, I don't, but could you send one.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Yes! I'll pop one in with the order. You'll find it a lot easier to remember what you need if you have our catalogue in front of you next time.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Yes, good idea. And when can you deliver this?
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Should be with you tomorrow morning.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Can you make sure that it's not after 11.30am because I have to go out at 12 there's only myself here on Fridays.
cues.speaker: Man

cues.text: Fine - I'll make a note on the delivery docket that they should deliver before half past eleven. Thanks very much.
cues.speaker: Woman

cues.text: Thanks.
cues.speaker: Man
